terminals.name: convex
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which default)"):$PATH"; cd projects/baby-outlet/backend && CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous pnpm dev:convex
